meta.title: VIETNAM under Rs.65000 for 2 PEOPLE | BUDGET breakdown | HANOI & SAPA | Complete guide 🇻🇳
meta.description:
Can you really travel to Vietnam for under ₹65,000 as a couple? 🇻🇳✨

In this video, we're sharing exactly how we planned and completed our 7 Days / 6 Nights Vietnam trip covering Hanoi and Sapa for under ₹65,000 for two people.

From flights, hotels, transportation, food, activities, shopping, and every major expense in between, we've broken down our complete budget so you can plan your own Vietnam trip with confidence.

Our itinerary:
📍 Hanoi (2 Days)
📍 Sapa (3 Days, 2 Nights)
📍 Hanoi (1.5 Days & 1 Night)

In this vlog, you'll find:
💰 Complete trip cost breakdown
✈️ Flight expenses and booking tips
🏨 Hotel recommendations
🚌 Hanoi to Sapa transportation details
🍜 Food and café recommendations
📸 Must visit attractions and experiences
🎒 Travel tips and things we learned along the way
🇻🇳 Honest insights on what is worth your money and what isn't

Whether you're planning your first international trip, looking for a budget friendly destination, or dreaming about visiting Vietnam, this video will help you understand the real costs of traveling through Hanoi and Sapa.

If you have any questions about Vietnam travel, leave them in the comments and we'll be happy to help.

📸 Follow our travel adventures: @dustysuitcases

#Vietnam #VietnamTravel #Hanoi #Sapa #VietnamBudgetTrip #VietnamTravelGuide #BudgetTravel #InternationalTravel #TravelVlog #DustySuitcases
